current_evidence: The council's validation checklist guidance page (wyre.gov.uk/validationchecklist) links only this file and says the checklist 'was updated in 2024', and the PDF reads 'Version 2.1, October 2024'; a search found no newer version or new consultation.

issues.detail: Many Wyre local requirements (WR) are missing from the app-type rows: WR.1 Affordable Housing Statement (10+ dwellings); WR.2 Agricultural Building Appraisal (new agricultural buildings in the countryside); WR.4 AONB Statement (in or near the Forest of Bowland AONB); WR.5 Biodiversity Report (protected species or habitats: bats for roof works within 100m of water/woodland or barn/church conversions; GCN within 250m of a pond; otter/water vole within 50m of a main river); WR.7 Business Plan (tourism accommodation, commercial stables); WR.8 Climate Change Statement (all development except householder and changes of use with no external alterations); WR.9 Coastal Change Management Area Statement; WR.10 Community Loss Statement (pubs, shops, community halls); WR.13 Equestrian Development Statement; WR.16 Green Infrastructure Impact Assessment (affecting open space/play/allotments, or 11+ net dwellings); WR.22 Management Plans (children's care homes C2, including change of use and LDCs); WR.23 Marketing Assessment (loss of employment/retail unit, change of use of a heritage asset); WR.25 Odour Assessment (as its own item); WR.27 Refuse and Recycling Statement (any development generating waste); WR.28 Retail Sequential Test and Impact Assessment (500 sqm+ retail / 2,500 sqm+ leisure impact thresholds).
issues.evidence: Section 2 Wyre Requirements WR.1, WR.2, WR.4, WR.5, WR.7-WR.10, WR.13, WR.16, WR.22, WR.23, WR.25, WR.27, WR.28

issues.detail: Most triggers describe the document's content, not when it is required. Air Quality: the source gives thresholds (within 500m of an AQMA, housing 80+ units or over 1ha, more than 60 extra vehicles/hour, more than 300 extra parking spaces). Arboricultural (WR.34): trees under a TPO, in a Conservation Area, of significant amenity value, on major development, or within influencing distance. Transport Assessment (WR.33): E(a)/D2 1,000 sqm+, E(g) 2,500 sqm+, or 100+ residential units. Lighting (WR.21): near homes, heritage assets, wildlife areas or countryside. Heritage (WR.17): any development that could affect a heritage asset. Planning Statement (WR.26): all major applications. Rural worker (WR.29): accommodation outside a settlement boundary. The Design and Access Statement trigger is cut off at 'for the following types of applications;'. Environmental Statement quotes a regulations citation instead of the Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 trigger. Contaminated land, Noise, Parking and Sequential Test are sentence fragments.
issues.evidence: WR.33: 'New or extended developments of 1,000 sqm ... E(a) or D2 ... 100 or more residential units'; NR.7 DAS: '10+ dwellings; outline 0.5ha+; 1,000 sqm+; 1ha+; LBC; CA/WHS 1+ dwellings or 100 sqm+'

issues.detail: LVIA is given as Schedule 1 EIA development only. WR.20 also covers wind turbines, pylons, telecoms masts, solar farms and schemes with significant landscape impact, including near the AONB or affecting the setting of a heritage asset. 'Housing mix' leaves out the rule that 20+ dwellings must include 20% for older or reduced-mobility people. 'BNG' quotes the national NR.9 text; the local WR.6 BNG Statement & Metric for outline and full applications is not captured.
issues.evidence: WR.20 LVIA 'When?'; WR.18: '20+ dwellings must include 20% designed for older people'

issues.detail: Some rows are mislabelled. 'Viability Assessment' is really WR.14 Existing Employment Viability Statement (effect on employment sites), not a developer viability appraisal. 'Odour / Dust / Vibration' quotes WR.24 vibration text. 'Ventilation / Extraction details (odour)' quotes the WR.25 Odour Assessment, whose trigger is an odour-emitting process near sensitive properties or sensitive development near an odour source.
issues.evidence: WR.14 'An existing employment viability statement is required for any development ... that has the potential to affect the existing employment areas'

issues.detail: Several rows are not requirements in the checklist. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' has the AIA tree-survey text as its trigger. 'Landscaping scheme' is a fragment from the AIA ('a proposed landscaping plan included with the AIA'). 'Photographs / Photomontages' is a content line ('recent and dated photographic evidence of the land'). 'Electric vehicle charging details' is the fragment 'standard charge Electric Vehicle Recharging (EVR) points.' and is not a standalone WR item. 'Habitats Regulations Assessment' is a garbled run of biodiversity source links into the WR.6 heading.
issues.evidence: Schedule of works trigger: 'and hedgerows, a method statement ... a tree constraints plan and a tree protection plan.'

issues.detail: Tab 'Submission rules' items are process text and fees: the 21-day notification for missing information and the extra 7 days before closure, the 10% service charge for invalid applications from 1 April 2023, 'only one paper copy is required', the right to request extra hard copies (which runs into the 'NR.8 Fire Statement ... Grenfell' heading), and the redacted-copy note.
issues.evidence: 'we will reserve the right to deduct 10% of the planning fee to cover administrative costs'

issues.detail: Rows were placed by keyword. 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' (WR.31) and 'Planning Obligations / S106' (WR.30) sit under Outline only, because the text says a statement 'should outline' the impacts. WR.31 applies to all development except householder, and WR.30 to all applications requiring S106. 'Flood Risk Assessment' sits only under 'Change of use - prior approval' because the text says 'including change of use'. WR.15 applies to all development in Flood Zones 2/3a/3b and to FZ1 sites of 1ha+ or at future risk.
issues.evidence: WR.31: 'All development except householder applications'; WR.15 FRA: 'An FRA is required for all development (including change of use): Within Flood Zones 2, 3a or 3b ...'

issues.detail: About 28 rows are flagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' (e.g. Air Quality, Arboricultural, Heritage, Lighting, Noise, Transport). Several application types wrongly show '(none)'. Listed building consent needs a DAS (NR.7) and a Heritage Statement (WR.17). Householder schemes can trigger WR.5 bat surveys (roof disturbance), WR.34 AIA, WR.17 Heritage and WR.15 FRA in Flood Zones 2/3. WR.8, WR.31 and WR.15 Sequential Test explicitly exclude or exempt householder, which the workbook does not record. Lawful development certificates for children's care homes need WR.22 Management Plans.
issues.evidence: NR.7: 'Listed Building Consent'; WR.22: 'Children's care homes (Use Class C2), including change of use and lawful development certificates'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Wyre Local Validation Checklist (Version 2.1, October 2024, linked from wyre.gov.uk/validationchecklist). Around 15 of the 34 local WR requirements are missing, including Affordable Housing, Biodiversity Report, Climate Change Statement, Green Infrastructure and Refuse. Most triggers are content descriptions or fragments, and several rows are mislabelled or placed under Outline or prior approval by keyword match.

withdrawn_issues.detail: The source gives a month only ('Version 2.1, October 2024'), but the workbook records 2024-10-01 as if that day were known. The month is correct. The guidance page notes the checklist is to be reviewed at least every two years, so a review is now due.
withdrawn_issues.evidence: PDF: 'Version 2.1 October 2024'; guidance page: 'reviewed periodically, at least every two years'
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: By workbook convention, List_date is always stored at month precision (YYYY-MM-01), so 2024-10-01 for "October 2024" is correct. The workbook already flags the list Outdated=Yes.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The workbook stores list dates to the month, so the value is right; only the date-basis label could be better. Not a Grokbot error.
